admissionInfo.text: Complete ENGL 2010 Intermediate Academic Writing and 30 hours of college-level courses other than German with a minimum GPA of 2.0 Complete lower division German courses [ GER 1010 Beginning German I , GER 1020 Beginning German II , GER 2010 Intermediate German I , and GER 2020G Intermediate German II ] or attain a similar level of language mastery through other means. Native speakers begin at the upper division level. Be admitted to a bachelor degree program at UVU.
